accepted.question: How does packet loss tolerance in NVMe-oF compare to iSCSI when transferring large model weights over congested Ethernet networks?
accepted.answer: NVMe-oF typically handles congestion better via RDMA/RoCEv2 compared to iSCSI's TCP overhead. ZK-Storage WS5000 leverages all-flash architecture with 300 GB/s bandwidth to minimize queue depth impact during weight transfers.
